as_of_content:
[[File:Teasercracker.png|center]]

The '''Thundercracker Challenge''' is a Challenge Mission featuring [[Thundercracker]] that ran from April 5 for two weeks. This runs in conjunction with the "[[No Bot Left Behind]]" ReForged Spotlight, and is similar to [[Bee's Gauntlet]].

== Synopsis ==
In a continuation of "[[Crossfire]]," Thundercracker arrives at New Quintessa to find [[Starscream]] commanding a squad of [[Sharkticon]]s.

=== Intro ===
{{dia|red|[[Marissa Faireborn]]|Commander? [[Optimus Prime|OPTIMUS]]? Teletraan found a break in the [[I Still Function|Re]][[Well, That's Just Primal|for]][[Galvatron Rising|ging]] interference.}}
{{dia|red|Optimus Prime|Thank Primus! It is good to hear from you again.}}
{{dia|red|Marissa|No time for pleasantries. [[Sharkticon]]s have been running wild since the planet started time-shifting. This break was the result of a massive [[energon]] explosion.}}
{{dia|red|Optimus Prime|Proposed path of action?}}
{{dia|grey|Scout [[Sharkticon]]|I have a suggestion. Surrender and submit to our leaders.}}
{{dia|red|Optimus Prime|Leaders? [[Starscream]] is finally [[Crossfire#To Eternity|sharing his new army]]?}}
{{diaC|grey|For some reason, these following lines only appear in the easiest difficulty.}}
{{dia|grey|Sharkticon|Our new leader and old leader. They unite us and divide us.}}
{{dia|red|Optimus Prime|This sounds like trouble. Commander, we better investigate.}}

=== Ending ===
{{dia|red|Optimus Prime|I hear shouting ahead. Stay alert.}}
{{diaRT|purple|Starscream|I DON'T CARE! THE SHARKTICONS ARE MINE TO COMMAND!}}
{{diaRT|purple|[[Thundercracker]]|I DIDN'T CRASH THROUGH A TIME FISSURE TO LISTEN TO YOUR WHINING!}}
{{diaRT|purple|Starscream|I WISH I COULD TOSS YOU INTO SPACE ALL OVER AGAIN! MY ARMY WILL SHATTER YOU, THUNDERCRACKER!}}
{{diaRT|purple|Thundercracker|YOU UGLY SCRAPHEAP! THOSE CREATURES SHALL BOW TO THE MIGHT OF MY FLIGHT!}}
{{diaRT|purple|Starscream|UGLY?! YOU LOOK IN A MIRROR LATELY?}}
{{diaC|grey|For some reason, the following line only appears in the easiest difficulty.}}
{{dia|red|Optimus Prime|Seems as though Starscream has met his match. I say we do the pair a favor and finish the fight.}}

== Layout ==
There are four difficulties, each named, "Trouble Brewing", "Rising Danger", "Critical Challenges", and "Thunder Struck". Each chapter is "Divided Army", "Split Leadership", "Signal Interference", and "Warped Relfection". There are six missions/rounds for each, each with six bots. All have a health boost and shared mod, and a unique mod for each bot.

=== Round 1 ===
Critical Rate, Health Boost
# Ultra Magnus - Melee Damage
# Bumblebee (GS) - Evade Power Gain
# Dinobot - Enhanced Special 1
# Windblade - Physical Resistance
# Optimus Prime - Special Attack Stun
# Kickback - Power Wipe 1

=== Round 2 ===
Improved Aim Enhancer, Health Boost
# Ironhide - Special Damage
# Arcee - Ranged Timed
# Ramjet - Special Damage Timed
# Hot Rod - Critical Damage
# Mixmaster - Power Flow Timed
# Bonecrusher - Melee Bleed

=== Round 3 ===
Power Charge, Health Boost +1
# Grimlock - Absorb Projectile
# Mirage - Ranged Power Burn
# Grindor - Adaptive
# Ratchet - Stagger
# Tantrum - Heavy Attack Stun
# Shockwave - Debuff Immunity

=== Round 4 ===
Life Transfer, Health Boost +1
# Bludgeon - Armor Pierce
# Galvatron - Reflect Ranged
# Hound - Enhanced Special I
# Waspinator - Enhanced Special 2
# Drift - Enhanced Bleed 2
# Megatron (ROTF) - Special Damage 2

=== Round 5 ===
Hacked Aim Enhancer, Health Boost +2
#Barricade - Trigger Rate
#G1 Megatron - Cycle Resist
#Jazz - Combo Shield
#Cyclonus - Shock Block
#Prowl - Critical Rate Timed
# Soundwave - Ranged Shock 3

=== Round 6 ===
Stagger, Health Boost +2
#Blaster - Defensive Power Gain
#Motormaster - Melee Damage
#Rhinox - Enhanced Bleed
#Optimus Primal - Evade Ranged Timed
#Starscream - Ranged Damage
# Thundercracker - Buff Duration

== Trivia ==
* The reasoning behind the ReForged Spotlight Missions is an "interference," according to [[Teletraan-I]].
* The name of the 4-Star chapter, "Thunder Struck," is a reference to the [[wikipedia:Thunderstruck (song)|AC/DC song of the same name]].
* This event was produced with the cooperation of two ''Forged to Fight'' streamers, Luke Connerton and Inqosly (iNightSkies).
* Starscream's quip about Thundercracker being "ugly" and "not looking at a mirror lately" is a reference to the fact he is a reskin.
